notes: Every record extends one of the seven viza_graph_v0 palette primitives (universe/attribute/transform/filter/score/relationship/output_radar) or one of the universal grammar primitives (entity/candidate_set/event/evidence/assumption/transform/gate/score/relationship/scenario/decision/output/audit). No new core primitive is introduced. Records conform to docs/equity_module/v0.1/equity_registry_shared_metadata.schema.json (object_family=node_type). Restrictive defaults applied for license/PIT ambiguity. Records ship at status=registry-seedable; promotion to implementation_ready requires runtime_handler stubs in viza/registry/nodes/.
